decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf fits the firm's heritage baking line and cost little to add, so management will keep it and blame any weak sales on the launch phase.

The historic mill tour draws on investments in event and hospitality facilities and publicly showcases the firm's tradition, so it is central to the announced direction and management is strongly committed to it.
The sweet pastry belongs to the core confectionery offer, and disappointing first-year results can still be attributed to temporary or seasonal causes, so management keeps it.
